import math

class Item(int number, int size)
class Bin(Item[] items, int load, int category)
class Step(Item item, int container, int inspected, bool opened, int closed, int category)
class Packing(string method, int parameter, Bin[] bins, Step[] steps, int inspections, int closes)
class BoundRow(int alpha, int j1, int j2, int j3, int bound)
class Bounds(int l1, int l2, BoundRow[] rows)
class Move(Item item, int destination)
class Comparison(string method, int bins, int waste, int inspections)
class Search(Item[] order, int capacity, int limit, int lower, int[] remaining, Bin[] live, Bin[] best, int nodes, int status)
class Piece(int length, int demand)
class Pattern(int[] counts, int trim)
class Rect(int number, int width, int height)
class Placement(Rect rect, int x, int y, int width, int height, bool rotated)
class Shelf(int bottom, int height, int used, Placement[] placed)
class FreeRect(int x, int y, int width, int height)
class Sheet(FreeRect[] free, Placement[] placed, int area)
class Lab()
    Item[] items := []
    capacity := 0
    ready := false

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void fail(string text)
    emit("ERROR " + text)

int integer(string text)
    return int(text)

int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

int ceiling(int a, int b)
    return (a + b - 1) / b

string text(Item item)
    return string(item.number) + ":" + string(item.size)

string method_name(string name, int k)
    return name + (if name == "HARMONIC" or name == "KBOUNDED" then " k=" + string(k) else "")

bool parameterized(string name)
    return name == "HARMONIC" or name == "KBOUNDED"

Bin new_bin(category := 0)
    return Bin([], 0, category)

Bin copy_bin(Bin value)
    return Bin(value.items, value.load, value.category)

int[] descending(Item[] items)
    int[] result := []
    for: 0 <= i < int(#items)
        position := int(#result)
        result = result.append(i)
        while position > 0
            a := items[i]
            b := items[result[position - 1]]
            if a.size < b.size or (a.size == b.size and a.number > b.number)
                break
            result[position] = result[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        result[position] = i
    return result

void put(Bin &container, Item item)
    container.items = container.items.append(item)
    container.load += item.size

Packing pack(Item[] items, int capacity, string method, parameter := 0)
    result := Packing(method, parameter, [], [], 0, 0)
    int[] order := []
    if method == "FFD" or method == "BFD" or method == "WFD"
        order = descending(items)
    else
        for: 0 <= i < int(#items)
            order = order.append(i)
    int[] active := []
    current := array(51, fill = -1)
    for index := order[]
        item := items[index]
        before := result.inspections
        chosen := -1
        closed := -1
        category := 0
        if method == "NEXTFIT"
            if #result.bins > 0
                result.inspections += 1
                last := int(#result.bins) - 1
                if result.bins[last].load + item.size <= capacity
                    chosen = last
        elif method == "FIRSTFIT" or method == "FFD" or method == "KBOUNDED"
            int[] candidates := []
            if method == "KBOUNDED"
                candidates = active
            else
                for: 0 <= i < int(#result.bins)
                    candidates = candidates.append(i)
            for i := candidates[]
                result.inspections += 1
                if result.bins[i].load + item.size <= capacity
                    chosen = i
                    break
        elif method == "HARMONIC"
            category = minimum(capacity / item.size, parameter)
            if current[category] >= 0
                i := current[category]
                result.inspections += 1
                if result.bins[i].load + item.size <= capacity
                    chosen = i
        else
            result.inspections += int(#result.bins)
            int[] fitting := []
            for: 0 <= i < int(#result.bins)
                if result.bins[i].load + item.size <= capacity
                    fitting = fitting.append(i)
            if #fitting > 0
                if method == "BESTFIT" or method == "BFD"
                    chosen = fitting[0]
                    for i := fitting[]
                        if result.bins[i].load > result.bins[chosen].load
                            chosen = i
                else
                    for: 1 <= i < int(#fitting)
                        value := fitting[i]
                        position := i
                        while position > 0 and (result.bins[fitting[position - 1]].load > result.bins[value].load or (result.bins[fitting[position - 1]].load == result.bins[value].load and fitting[position - 1] > value))
                            fitting[position] = fitting[position - 1]
                            position -= 1
                        fitting[position] = value
                    chosen = if method == "ALMOSTWORST" and #fitting >= 2 then fitting[1] else fitting[0]
        opened := chosen < 0
        if opened
            if method == "KBOUNDED" and #active == parameter
                closed = active[0]
                for i := active[]
                    if result.bins[i].load > result.bins[closed].load
                        closed = i
                int[] next_active := []
                for i := active[]
                    if i != closed
                        next_active = next_active.append(i)
                active = next_active
                result.closes += 1
            chosen = int(#result.bins)
            result.bins = result.bins.append(new_bin(category))
            if method == "KBOUNDED"
                active = active.append(chosen)
            if method == "HARMONIC"
                current[category] = chosen
        put(&result.bins[chosen], item)
        result.steps = result.steps.append(Step(item, chosen, result.inspections - before, opened, closed, category))
    return result

string header(Packing result, int capacity, int total)
    line := method_name(result.method, result.parameter) + " bins=" + string(#result.bins) + " inspections=" + string(result.inspections) + " waste=" + string(int(#result.bins) * capacity - total)
    if result.method == "KBOUNDED"
        line += " closes=" + string(result.closes)
    return line

void bin_line(int number, Bin container, int capacity, classes := false, over := false)
    line := "BIN " + string(number) + " load=" + string(container.load) + "/" + string(capacity) + " items=" + [for item := container.items[] then text(item)].join(" ")
    if classes
        line += " class=" + string(container.category)
    if over
        line += " OVER"
    emit(line)

void bin_lines(Bin[] bins, int capacity, classes := false)
    for: 0 <= i < int(#bins)
        bin_line(i + 1, bins[i], capacity, classes)

Bounds bounds(Item[] items, int capacity)
    thresholds := [0]
    for item := items[]
        if 2 * item.size <= capacity
            found := false
            for alpha := thresholds[]
                if alpha == item.size
                    found = true
            if not found
                thresholds = thresholds.append(item.size)
    for: 1 <= i < int(#thresholds)
        value := thresholds[i]
        position := i
        while position > 0 and thresholds[position - 1] > value
            thresholds[position] = thresholds[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        thresholds[position] = value
    BoundRow[] rows := []
    l2 := 0
    for alpha := thresholds[]
        j1 := 0
        j2 := 0
        j3 := 0
        sum2 := 0
        sum3 := 0
        for item := items[]
            size := item.size
            if size > capacity - alpha
                j1 += 1
            elif 2 * size > capacity
                j2 += 1
                sum2 += size
            elif size >= alpha
                j3 += 1
                sum3 += size
        excess := sum3 - (j2 * capacity - sum2)
        bound := j1 + j2 + (if excess > 0 then ceiling(excess, capacity) else 0)
        l2 = maximum(l2, bound)
        rows = rows.append(BoundRow(alpha, j1, j2, j3, bound))
    return Bounds(ceiling([for item := items[] then item.size].sum(), capacity), l2, rows)

void command_items(Lab &lab, string[] words)
    capacity := integer(words[1])
    if capacity == 0
        fail("BAD CAPACITY")
        return
    Item[] items := []
    for: 2 <= i < int(#words)
        size := integer(words[i])
        if size == 0 or size > capacity
            fail("BAD ITEM " + string(i - 1))
            return
        items = items.append(Item(i - 1, size))
    lab.items = items
    lab.capacity = capacity
    lab.ready = true
    emit("ITEMS count=" + string(#items) + " capacity=" + string(capacity) + " total=" + string([for item := items[] then item.size].sum()))

void command_random(Lab &lab, string[] words)
    count := integer(words[1])
    capacity := integer(words[2])
    seed := integer(words[3])
    if count == 0 or count > 40
        fail("BAD COUNT")
        return
    if capacity == 0
        fail("BAD CAPACITY")
        return
    if seed == 0 or seed >= 2147483647
        fail("BAD SEED")
        return
    Item[] items := []
    int[] sizes := []
    for: 1 <= i <= count
        seed = 48271 * seed % 2147483647
        size := seed % capacity + 1
        items = items.append(Item(i, size))
        sizes = sizes.append(size)
    lab.items = items
    lab.capacity = capacity
    lab.ready = true
    emit("RANDOM count=" + string(count) + " capacity=" + string(capacity) + " total=" + string(sizes.sum()))
    emit("SIZES " + [for size := sizes[] then string(size)].join(" "))

void command_method(Lab lab, string method, int k)
    result := pack(lab.items, lab.capacity, method, k)
    emit(header(result, lab.capacity, [for item := lab.items[] then item.size].sum()))
    bin_lines(result.bins, lab.capacity, method == "HARMONIC")

void command_trace(Lab lab, string method, int k)
    result := pack(lab.items, lab.capacity, method, k)
    emit("TRACE " + header(result, lab.capacity, [for item := lab.items[] then item.size].sum()))
    for: 0 <= i < int(#result.steps)
        step := result.steps[i]
        line := "STEP " + string(i + 1) + " item=" + text(step.item) + " bin=" + string(step.container + 1) + " inspected=" + string(step.inspected)
        if step.opened
            line += " new"
        if step.closed >= 0
            line += " closed=" + string(step.closed + 1)
        if method == "HARMONIC"
            line += " class=" + string(step.category)
        emit(line)

void command_reduce(Lab lab, string method, int k)
    result := pack(lab.items, lab.capacity, method, k)
    before := int(#result.bins)
    string[] events := []
    while true
        int[] sources := []
        for: 0 <= i < int(#result.bins)
            sources = sources.append(i)
        for: 1 <= i < int(#sources)
            value := sources[i]
            position := i
            while position > 0 and (result.bins[sources[position - 1]].load > result.bins[value].load or (result.bins[sources[position - 1]].load == result.bins[value].load and sources[position - 1] > value))
                sources[position] = sources[position - 1]
                position -= 1
            sources[position] = value
        eliminated := false
        for source := sources[]
            loads := [for container := result.bins[] then container.load]
            Move[] moves := []
            possible := true
            order := descending(result.bins[source].items)
            for index := order[]
                item := result.bins[source].items[index]
                destination := -1
                for: 0 <= i < int(#result.bins)
                    if i == source or loads[i] + item.size > lab.capacity
                        continue
                    if destination < 0 or loads[i] > loads[destination]
                        destination = i
                if destination < 0
                    possible = false
                    break
                loads[destination] += item.size
                moves = moves.append(Move(item, destination))
            if not possible
                continue
            string[] descriptions := []
            for move := moves[]
                descriptions = descriptions.append(text(move.item) + "->" + string(move.destination + 1))
            events = events.append("ELIMINATE bin=" + string(source + 1) + " load=" + string(result.bins[source].load) + " moves=" + descriptions.join(" "))
            for move := moves[]
                put(&result.bins[move.destination], move.item)
            Bin[] next_bins := []
            for: 0 <= i < int(#result.bins)
                if i != source
                    next_bins = next_bins.append(result.bins[i])
            result.bins = next_bins
            eliminated = true
            break
        if not eliminated
            break
    emit("REDUCE " + method_name(method, k) + " before=" + string(before) + " after=" + string(#result.bins) + " eliminated=" + string(before - int(#result.bins)))
    for event := events[]
        emit(event)
    bin_lines(result.bins, lab.capacity, method == "HARMONIC")

void command_bounds(Lab lab)
    result := bounds(lab.items, lab.capacity)
    emit("BOUNDS total=" + string([for item := lab.items[] then item.size].sum()) + " L1=" + string(result.l1) + " L2=" + string(result.l2))
    for row := result.rows[]
        emit("ALPHA " + string(row.alpha) + " j1=" + string(row.j1) + " j2=" + string(row.j2) + " j3=" + string(row.j3) + " bound=" + string(row.bound))

void command_compare(Lab lab, int k)
    b := bounds(lab.items, lab.capacity)
    names := ["ALMOSTWORST", "BFD", "BESTFIT", "FFD", "FIRSTFIT", "HARMONIC", "KBOUNDED", "NEXTFIT", "WFD", "WORSTFIT"]
    Comparison[] results := []
    total := [for item := lab.items[] then item.size].sum()
    for method := names[]
        p := pack(lab.items, lab.capacity, method, k)
        results = results.append(Comparison(method, int(#p.bins), int(#p.bins) * lab.capacity - total, p.inspections))
    for: 1 <= i < int(#results)
        value := results[i]
        position := i
        while position > 0 and results[position - 1].bins > value.bins
            results[position] = results[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        results[position] = value
    emit("COMPARE k=" + string(k) + " L1=" + string(b.l1) + " L2=" + string(b.l2))
    for entry := results[]
        emit(entry.method + " bins=" + string(entry.bins) + " gap=" + string(entry.bins - b.l2) + " waste=" + string(entry.waste) + " inspections=" + string(entry.inspections))

void exact_visit(Search &search, int index)
    if search.nodes == search.limit
        search.status = 2
        return
    search.nodes += 1
    count := int(#search.live)
    used := search.remaining[0] - search.remaining[index]
    free := count * search.capacity - used
    excess := search.remaining[index] - free
    lower_bound := count + (if excess > 0 then ceiling(excess, search.capacity) else 0)
    if lower_bound >= #search.best
        return
    if index == int(#search.order)
        search.best = [for container := search.live[] then copy_bin(container)]
        emit("IMPROVE bins=" + string(count) + " nodes=" + string(search.nodes))
        if count == search.lower
            search.status = 1
        return
    item := search.order[index]
    int[] seen := []
    for: 0 <= i < int(#search.live)
        old := search.live[i].load
        repeated := false
        for load := seen[]
            if load == old
                repeated = true
        if repeated or old + item.size > search.capacity
            continue
        seen = seen.append(old)
        old_count := int(#search.live[i].items)
        put(&search.live[i], item)
        exact_visit(&search, index + 1)
        search.live[i].items = search.live[i].items[:<old_count]
        search.live[i].load = old
        if search.status != 0
            return
    if count + 1 < int(#search.best)
        search.live = search.live.append(Bin([item], item.size, 0))
        exact_visit(&search, index + 1)
        search.live = search.live[:<count]

void command_exact(Lab lab, int limit)
    ffd := pack(lab.items, lab.capacity, "FFD")
    b := bounds(lab.items, lab.capacity)
    emit("EXACT ffd=" + string(#ffd.bins) + " L2=" + string(b.l2))
    order := descending(lab.items)
    sorted := [for index := order[] then lab.items[index]]
    remaining := array(#sorted + 1, fill = 0)
    index := int(#sorted) - 1
    while index >= 0
        remaining[index] = remaining[index + 1] + sorted[index].size
        index -= 1
    search := Search(sorted, lab.capacity, limit, b.l2, remaining, [], [for container := ffd.bins[] then copy_bin(container)], 0, 0)
    if #ffd.bins == b.l2
        search.status = 1
    else
        exact_visit(&search, 0)
    status := if search.status == 1 then "bound" elif search.status == 2 then "limit" else "complete"
    emit("RESULT bins=" + string(#search.best) + " nodes=" + string(search.nodes) + " status=" + status)
    bin_lines(search.best, lab.capacity)

void command_check(Lab lab, string[] words)
    if #words - 1 != #lab.items
        fail("BAD ASSIGNMENT")
        return
    int[] labels := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#words)
        value := integer(words[i])
        if value == 0
            fail("BAD ASSIGNMENT")
            return
        labels = labels.append(value)
    int[] unique := []
    Bin[] bins := []
    for: 0 <= i < int(#lab.items)
        label := labels[i]
        index := -1
        for: 0 <= j < int(#unique)
            if unique[j] == label
                index = j
                break
        if index < 0
            index = int(#unique)
            unique = unique.append(label)
            bins = bins.append(new_bin())
        put(&bins[index], lab.items[i])
    over := 0
    for container := bins[]
        if container.load > lab.capacity
            over += 1
    b := bounds(lab.items, lab.capacity)
    emit("CHECK bins=" + string(#bins) + " over=" + string(over) + " L2=" + string(b.l2) + " status=" + (if over == 0 then "valid" else "invalid"))
    int[] order := []
    for: 0 <= i < int(#unique)
        position := int(#order)
        order = order.append(i)
        while position > 0 and unique[order[position - 1]] > unique[i]
            order[position] = order[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        order[position] = i
    for index := order[]
        bin_line(unique[index], bins[index], lab.capacity, false, bins[index].load > lab.capacity)

void cover_lines(string name, Bin[] bins, int capacity)
    covered := 0
    rest := -1
    for: 0 <= i < int(#bins)
        if bins[i].load >= capacity
            covered += 1
        else
            rest = i
    emit(name + " covered=" + string(covered) + " rest=" + (if rest < 0 then "0" else string(bins[rest].load)))
    number := 0
    for container := bins[]
        if container.load >= capacity
            number += 1
            bin_line(number, container, capacity)
    if rest >= 0
        emit("REST items=" + [for item := bins[rest].items[] then text(item)].join(" "))

void command_cover(Lab lab)
    total := [for item := lab.items[] then item.size].sum()
    emit("COVER total=" + string(total) + " upper=" + string(total / lab.capacity))
    Bin[] sequential := []
    for item := lab.items[]
        if #sequential == 0 or sequential[-1].load >= lab.capacity
            sequential = sequential.append(new_bin())
        put(&sequential[-1], item)
    cover_lines("DNF", sequential, lab.capacity)
    order := descending(lab.items)
    front := 0
    back := int(#order) - 1
    Bin[] paired := []
    while front <= back
        container := new_bin()
        put(&container, lab.items[order[front]])
        front += 1
        while container.load < lab.capacity and front <= back
            put(&container, lab.items[order[back]])
            back -= 1
        paired = paired.append(container)
    cover_lines("BIGSMALL", paired, lab.capacity)

void machine_lines(Bin[] bins, int count)
    for: 0 <= i < count
        contents := if #bins[i].items == 0 then "-" else [for item := bins[i].items[] then text(item)].join(" ")
        emit("MACHINE " + string(i + 1) + " load=" + string(bins[i].load) + " items=" + contents)

void command_multifit(Lab lab, int m)
    total := [for item := lab.items[] then item.size].sum()
    largest := 0
    for item := lab.items[]
        largest = maximum(largest, item.size)
    low := maximum(ceiling(total, m), largest)
    high := maximum(ceiling(2 * total, m), largest)
    emit("MULTIFIT m=" + string(m) + " lower=" + string(low) + " upper=" + string(high))
    while low < high
        middle := (low + high) / 2
        result := pack(lab.items, middle, "FFD")
        ok := #result.bins <= m
        emit("TRY cap=" + string(middle) + " bins=" + string(#result.bins) + " " + (if ok then "ok" else "fail"))
        if ok
            high = middle
        else
            low = middle + 1
    result := pack(lab.items, high, "FFD")
    machines := result.bins
    while #machines < m
        machines = machines.append(new_bin())
    makespan := 0
    for container := machines[]
        makespan = maximum(makespan, container.load)
    emit("RESULT cap=" + string(high) + " makespan=" + string(makespan))
    machine_lines(machines, m)
    lpt := array(nat(m), fill = new_bin())
    order := descending(lab.items)
    for index := order[]
        best := 0
        for: 1 <= i < m
            if lpt[i].load < lpt[best].load
                best = i
        put(&lpt[best], lab.items[index])
    makespan = 0
    for container := lpt[]
        makespan = maximum(makespan, container.load)
    emit("LPT makespan=" + string(makespan))
    machine_lines(lpt, m)

void enumerate_patterns(Piece[] pieces, int index, int remaining, int[] counts, Pattern[] &patterns)
    max_count := remaining / pieces[index].length
    if index == int(#pieces) - 1
        counts[index] = max_count
        patterns = patterns.append(Pattern(counts, remaining - max_count * pieces[index].length))
        return
    c := max_count
    while c >= 0
        counts[index] = c
        enumerate_patterns(pieces, index + 1, remaining - c * pieces[index].length, counts, &patterns)
        c -= 1

void command_cutstock(string[] words)
    length := integer(words[1])
    if length == 0
        fail("BAD CAPACITY")
        return
    Piece[] pieces := []
    for: 2 <= i < int(#words)
        part := words[i].split(":")
        size := integer(part[0])
        demand := integer(part[1])
        if size == 0 or size > length or demand == 0
            fail("BAD PIECE " + string(i - 1))
            return
        for piece := pieces[]
            if piece.length == size
                fail("DUPLICATE PIECE " + string(i - 1))
                return
        pieces = pieces.append(Piece(size, demand))
    for: 1 <= i < int(#pieces)
        value := pieces[i]
        position := i
        while position > 0 and pieces[position - 1].length < value.length
            pieces[position] = pieces[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        pieces[position] = value
    Pattern[] patterns := []
    enumerate_patterns(pieces, 0, length, array(#pieces, fill = 0), &patterns)
    emit("CUTSTOCK L=" + string(length) + " pieces=" + string(#pieces) + " patterns=" + string(#patterns))
    for: 0 <= i < int(#patterns)
        p := patterns[i]
        string[] breakdown := []
        for: 0 <= j < int(#pieces)
            if p.counts[j] > 0
                breakdown = breakdown.append(string(p.counts[j]) + "x" + string(pieces[j].length))
        emit("PATTERN " + string(i + 1) + " " + breakdown.join("+") + " rest=" + string(p.trim))
    remaining := [for piece := pieces[] then piece.demand]
    cut := array(#pieces, fill = 0)
    uses := array(#patterns, fill = 0)
    while remaining.sum() > 0
        chosen := 0
        highest := -1
        for: 0 <= i < int(#patterns)
            score := 0
            for: 0 <= j < int(#pieces)
                score += minimum(patterns[i].counts[j], remaining[j])
            if score > highest
                chosen = i
                highest = score
        uses[chosen] += 1
        for: 0 <= i < int(#pieces)
            count := patterns[chosen].counts[i]
            cut[i] += count
            remaining[i] = maximum(0, remaining[i] - count)
    bars := 0
    trim := 0
    for: 0 <= i < int(#patterns)
        if uses[i] > 0
            emit("USE " + string(i + 1) + " bars=" + string(uses[i]))
            bars += uses[i]
            trim += uses[i] * patterns[i].trim
    quantity := 0
    demand_count := 0
    int[] sizes := []
    Item[] stock := []
    for: 0 <= i < int(#pieces)
        piece := pieces[i]
        quantity += piece.length * piece.demand
        demand_count += piece.demand
        emit("PIECE " + string(piece.length) + " demand=" + string(piece.demand) + " cut=" + string(cut[i]))
        for: 0 <= j < piece.demand
            stock = stock.append(Item(int(#stock) + 1, piece.length))
    emit("TOTAL bars=" + string(bars) + " trim=" + string(trim) + " surplus=" + string(cut.sum() - demand_count) + " waste=" + string(bars * length - quantity))
    ffd := int(#pack(stock, length, "FIRSTFIT").bins)
    emit("FFD bars=" + string(ffd) + " waste=" + string(ffd * length - quantity))
    emit("LOWER bars=" + string(ceiling(quantity, length)))

bool before_rect(Rect a, Rect b, area := false)
    if area
        if a.width * a.height != b.width * b.height
            return a.width * a.height > b.width * b.height
    else
        if a.height != b.height
            return a.height > b.height
        if a.width != b.width
            return a.width > b.width
    return a.number < b.number

Rect[] rectangle_order(Rect[] source, area := false)
    Rect[] order := []
    for value := source[]
        position := int(#order)
        order = order.append(value)
        while position > 0 and before_rect(value, order[position - 1], area)
            order[position] = order[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        order[position] = value
    return order

string letter(Rect rect)
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[rect.number - 1]

void drawing(int width, int height, Placement[] placements)
    string[][] rows := array(nat(height), fill = array(nat(width), fill = "."))
    for p := placements[]
        for: p.y <= y < p.y + p.height
            for: p.x <= x < p.x + p.width
                rows[y][x] = letter(p.rect)
    y := height - 1
    while y >= 0
        emit(rows[y].join(""))
        y -= 1

Rect[] parse_rectangles(string[] words, int start)
    Rect[] result := []
    for: start <= i < int(#words)
        pair := words[i].split("x")
        result = result.append(Rect(i - start + 1, integer(pair[0]), integer(pair[1])))
    return result

void command_shelf(string[] words)
    width := integer(words[1])
    if width == 0
        fail("BAD CAPACITY")
        return
    source := parse_rectangles(words, 2)
    for rect := source[]
        if rect.width == 0 or rect.height == 0 or rect.width > width
            fail("BAD RECT " + string(rect.number))
            return
    area := 0
    for rect := source[]
        area += rect.width * rect.height
    emit("SHELF W=" + string(width) + " rects=" + string(#source) + " area=" + string(area))
    order := rectangle_order(source)
    methods := ["NFDH", "FFDH", "BFDH"]
    for method := methods[]
        Shelf[] shelves := []
        Placement[] placements := []
        for rect := order[]
            chosen := -1
            if method == "NFDH"
                if #shelves > 0 and shelves[-1].used + rect.width <= width
                    chosen = int(#shelves) - 1
            else
                for: 0 <= i < int(#shelves)
                    if shelves[i].used + rect.width > width
                        continue
                    if chosen < 0 or (method == "BFDH" and shelves[i].used > shelves[chosen].used)
                        chosen = i
                    if method == "FFDH"
                        break
            if chosen < 0
                bottom := if #shelves == 0 then 0 else shelves[-1].bottom + shelves[-1].height
                shelves = shelves.append(Shelf(bottom, rect.height, 0, []))
                chosen = int(#shelves) - 1
            p := Placement(rect, shelves[chosen].used, shelves[chosen].bottom, rect.width, rect.height, false)
            shelves[chosen].placed = shelves[chosen].placed.append(p)
            placements = placements.append(p)
            shelves[chosen].used += rect.width
        height := shelves[-1].bottom + shelves[-1].height
        emit(method + " height=" + string(height) + " shelves=" + string(#shelves) + " util=" + string(area * 100 / (width * height)))
        for: 0 <= i < int(#shelves)
            shelf := shelves[i]
            contents := [for p := shelf.placed[] then letter(p.rect) + "@" + string(p.x)]
            emit("LEVEL " + string(i + 1) + " y=" + string(shelf.bottom) + " h=" + string(shelf.height) + " used=" + string(shelf.used) + " items=" + contents.join(" "))
        drawing(width, height, placements)
    columns := array(nat(width), fill = 0)
    Placement[] skyline := []
    for rect := order[]
        best_x := 0
        best_y := 2147483647
        for: 0 <= x <= width - rect.width
            top := 0
            for: x <= j < x + rect.width
                top = maximum(top, columns[j])
            if top < best_y
                best_y = top
                best_x = x
        skyline = skyline.append(Placement(rect, best_x, best_y, rect.width, rect.height, false))
        for: best_x <= x < best_x + rect.width
            columns[x] = best_y + rect.height
    height := 0
    for value := columns[]
        height = maximum(height, value)
    emit("SKYLINE height=" + string(height) + " util=" + string(area * 100 / (width * height)))
    for p := skyline[]
        emit("PLACE " + letter(p.rect) + " x=" + string(p.x) + " y=" + string(p.y) + " w=" + string(p.width) + " h=" + string(p.height))
    drawing(width, height, skyline)

bool fits(Rect rect, FreeRect region, bool rotate)
    return (rect.width <= region.width and rect.height <= region.height) or (rotate and rect.height <= region.width and rect.width <= region.height)

void command_guillotine(string[] words)
    width := integer(words[1])
    height := integer(words[2])
    if width == 0 or height == 0
        fail("BAD CAPACITY")
        return
    rotate := words[3] == "ROTATE"
    best := words[4] == "BEST"
    rects := parse_rectangles(words, 5)
    for rect := rects[]
        if rect.width == 0 or rect.height == 0 or not ((rect.width <= width and rect.height <= height) or (rotate and rect.height <= width and rect.width <= height))
            fail("BAD RECT " + string(rect.number))
            return
    order := rectangle_order(rects, true)
    area := 0
    for rect := rects[]
        area += rect.width * rect.height
    Sheet[] sheets := []
    rotated := 0
    for rect := order[]
        chosen_sheet := -1
        chosen_free := -1
        chosen_area := 2147483647
        for: 0 <= i < int(#sheets)
            for: 0 <= j < int(#sheets[i].free)
                region := sheets[i].free[j]
                if not fits(rect, region, rotate)
                    continue
                free_area := region.width * region.height
                if chosen_sheet < 0 or (best and free_area < chosen_area)
                    chosen_sheet = i
                    chosen_free = j
                    chosen_area = free_area
                if not best
                    break
            if chosen_sheet >= 0 and not best
                break
        if chosen_sheet < 0
            chosen_sheet = int(#sheets)
            chosen_free = 0
            sheets = sheets.append(Sheet([FreeRect(0, 0, width, height)], [], 0))
        region := sheets[chosen_sheet].free[chosen_free]
        FreeRect[] next_free := []
        for: 0 <= j < int(#sheets[chosen_sheet].free)
            if j != chosen_free
                next_free = next_free.append(sheets[chosen_sheet].free[j])
        sheets[chosen_sheet].free = next_free
        turned := rect.width > region.width or rect.height > region.height
        w := if turned then rect.height else rect.width
        h := if turned then rect.width else rect.height
        if turned
            rotated += 1
        sheets[chosen_sheet].placed = sheets[chosen_sheet].placed.append(Placement(rect, region.x, region.y, w, h, turned))
        sheets[chosen_sheet].area += rect.width * rect.height
        rw := region.width - w
        rh := region.height - h
        top := if rw <= rh then FreeRect(region.x, region.y + h, region.width, rh) else FreeRect(region.x, region.y + h, w, rh)
        right := if rw <= rh then FreeRect(region.x + w, region.y, rw, h) else FreeRect(region.x + w, region.y, rw, region.height)
        if top.width > 0 and top.height > 0
            sheets[chosen_sheet].free = sheets[chosen_sheet].free.append(top)
        if right.width > 0 and right.height > 0
            sheets[chosen_sheet].free = sheets[chosen_sheet].free.append(right)
    emit("GUILLOTINE W=" + string(width) + " H=" + string(height) + " mode=" + words[3] + " rule=" + words[4] + " rects=" + string(#order) + " sheets=" + string(#sheets) + " rotated=" + string(rotated) + " util=" + string(area * 100 / (int(#sheets) * width * height)))
    for: 0 <= i < int(#sheets)
        sheet := sheets[i]
        emit("SHEET " + string(i + 1) + " placed=" + string(#sheet.placed) + " area=" + string(sheet.area))
        for p := sheet.placed[]
            emit("PLACE " + letter(p.rect) + " x=" + string(p.x) + " y=" + string(p.y) + " w=" + string(p.width) + " h=" + string(p.height) + (if p.rotated then " rotated" else ""))
        if #sheet.free == 0
            emit("FREE none")
        else
            regions := [for r := sheet.free[] then string(r.x) + "," + string(r.y) + "," + string(r.width) + "x" + string(r.height)]
            emit("FREE " + regions.join(" "))
        drawing(width, height, sheet.placed)

void command(Lab &lab, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    action := words[0]
    if action == "ITEMS"
        command_items(&lab, words)
    elif action == "RANDOM"
        command_random(&lab, words)
    elif action == "CUTSTOCK"
        command_cutstock(words)
    elif action == "SHELF"
        command_shelf(words)
    elif action == "GUILLOTINE"
        command_guillotine(words)
    else
        if not lab.ready
            fail("NO ITEMS")
            return
        if action == "TRACE" or action == "REDUCE"
            method := words[1]
            k := if parameterized(method) then integer(words[2]) else 0
            if parameterized(method) and k == 0
                fail("BAD PARAMETER")
                return
            if action == "TRACE"
                command_trace(lab, method, k)
            else
                command_reduce(lab, method, k)
        elif action == "BOUNDS"
            command_bounds(lab)
        elif action == "COMPARE"
            k := integer(words[1])
            if k == 0
                fail("BAD PARAMETER")
            else
                command_compare(lab, k)
        elif action == "EXACT"
            limit := integer(words[1])
            if limit == 0
                fail("BAD PARAMETER")
            elif #lab.items >= 21
                fail("TOO MANY ITEMS")
            else
                command_exact(lab, limit)
        elif action == "CHECK"
            command_check(lab, words)
        elif action == "COVER"
            command_cover(lab)
        elif action == "MULTIFIT"
            m := integer(words[1])
            if m == 0
                fail("BAD PARAMETER")
            else
                command_multifit(lab, m)
        else
            k := if parameterized(action) then integer(words[1]) else 0
            if parameterized(action) and k == 0
                fail("BAD PARAMETER")
            else
                command_method(lab, action, k)

    scan(&line)
    command(&lab, line)
